title: Grade 4 French — Fri, Jun 05
description: Verbes en -IR (2e groupe) — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis and -ER vs -IR contrast
subject: french

questions.question: Which set of endings belongs to the 2nd group (-IR verbs)?
questions.explanation: 2nd group -IR: -is, -is, -it, -issons, -issez, -issent. The -iss- in the plural is the key marker.

questions.question: Which verb is a 2nd-group -IR verb?
questions.explanation: 'Finir' is a 2nd-group -IR verb. Manger, parler, habiter are -ER verbs (1st group).

questions.question: Complete: '-ER verb → je mange. -IR verb → je ___ (finir).'
questions.explanation: -ER: je mange (-e). -IR: je finis (-is). The endings are different.

questions.question: Find the error: 'Les enfants grandit vite.'
questions.explanation: 'Les enfants' is plural → 'grandissent' (not grandit). Correct: 'Les enfants grandissent vite.'

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Both 'je' and 'tu' take -is: 'Je finis et tu choisis.'

questions.question: Find the error: 'Nous finons nos devoirs.'
Complete the paragraph: 'Nous ___ (réfléchir), puis nous ___ (choisir) une réponse.'
questions.explanation: Both with 'nous' → -issons: 'Nous réfléchissons, puis nous choisissons une réponse.'

questions.question: Translate: 'The children grow and the flowers grow too.'
options: Les enfants grandissent et les fleurs grandissent aussi.
Les enfants grandit et les fleurs grandit aussi.
Les enfants grandissons et les fleurs grandissez aussi.
Les enfants grandis et les fleurs grandis aussi.
questions.explanation: Both subjects are plural → 'grandissent'. 'Les enfants grandissent et les fleurs grandissent aussi.'

questions.question: Week summary: what makes a verb belong to the 2nd group?
options: It ends in -IR AND adds -iss- in the plural (like finir)
questions.explanation: A 2nd-group verb ends in -IR and takes -iss- in the plural (nous finissons). Some -IR verbs (partir, dormir) do NOT add -iss- — they belong to the 3rd group, learned later.
